# GH workflow

## gh-create-work-issue

```bash
.cursor/scripts/gh-create-work-issue.sh -t "Title" -F body.md
.cursor/scripts/gh-create-work-issue.sh -t "Title" -F body.md --parent <N> --blocked-by <N>
.cursor/scripts/gh-create-work-issue.sh -t "Title" -F body.md --repo owner/repo
.cursor/scripts/gh-create-work-issue.sh -t "Title" -F body.md -l label[,label]
.cursor/scripts/gh-create-work-issue.sh -t "Title" -F body.md --comment-on <N>
```

Флаги: `--repo`, `--parent`, `--blocked-by`, `--blocking`, `-l`, `--comment-on`.

Требуется `gh` ≥ 2.94.0 (relations и часть флагов `gh issue create`).
